title: umbrella-config
description: Aliases of the swissknifeman umbrella CLI (configs/umbrella.json).

version.description: Where the umbrella version comes from when git describe fails.

fallback_file.description: JSON file relative to the hub root.

plugins.description: Plugins the hub root ships itself (the umbrella face); aicore.content.marketplace reads them like the provides.plugins of a module, package `root`.

manifest.description: Its .claude-plugin/plugin.json, relative to the hub root.

source.description: Its folder, relative to the hub root.

partner_env.description: Environment names under which the partners of a module look up its install root, by module id: each variable maps to a path relative to the module root ('.' is the root). A routed module gets them for every discovered module; a module not listed is SKM_<ID>_ROOT; a variable already set wins.

routes.description: Routes tried in order; the first whose when matches wins.

route.description: One route: a module or a hub script, with a fixed argument prefix.

when.description: Condition on the first argument after the alias; absent means always.

first_in.description: The first argument is one of these.

first_empty_or_flag.description: There is no first argument or it starts with a dash.

unit.description: Module id whose first provides.cli entry runs.

script.description: Script path relative to the hub root.

argv_prefix.description: Arguments put before the user arguments.

drop_first.description: Remove the first user argument (the one that matched when).
